title: fix(console): draw a new AI chat conversation's first message at once, and give its text back when the create fails
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGSudkpvjYSMB3ZosFUW2qM)_

Fixes #33420

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5oYya4wGgRN7g6MEWJ` · claim 6885536750 (and its two amendments: the conversation hook, then the dock and Studio hosts)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 对话新建会话时,用户发出的第一条消息立刻以用户气泡出现在对话里(下面是助手的「思考中」小点),等 `POST /conversations` 返回、会话打开后正常发出,且只显示一次;等待期间再发的第二条会并进第一条一起显示。创建会话失败时,气泡撤掉,文字放回输入框,并显示「消息未发送」提示(与现有发送失败的处理一致),不再把消息悄悄藏着等下一次一起发。全页 AI 对话、控制台侧边对话和 Studio 助手三处都生效。
- 为什么改:#32984 报告新会话第一条消息要等约 5 秒才出现;原因是第一条消息在会话 id 生成前被暂存在页面里、不进对话,创建失败时也没有任何回滚信号。
- 风险与回滚:只改 app-shell(私有包,随 console 发布)的前端显示和会话 hook 的失败上报,不改服务端、不改 spec、不改已有会话的发送路径。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx(`useDeferredFirstSend` 新增 `onHeldChange` / `createError`,`ChatPane` 的 `shownMessages`)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts(`createError` 的设置与清除)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDockConversation.tsx(一行传参)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev,打开 `/ai/build`,在浏览器开发者工具里把 `POST /conversations` 节流到很慢,发一条消息:气泡立刻出现;放开后只出现一条且收到回复。再把该请求设为失败:气泡消失,文字回到输入框,出现未发送提示。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

On a new conversation the first send is what creates the conversation (`useChatConversation().ensureConversation`, objectstack#32031), and `ChatPane` is keyed on the conversation id, so `useDeferredFirstSend` holds the message in the host-owned stash until the id lands and the pane remounts. Measured on `origin/main` f068cde8 with the rendered pins below: while the create is held open the thread draws nothing, and when the create fails the composer stays empty, nothing is shown, and the text sits in the stash to be sent with whatever the user sends next.

- **The held message is drawn.** `useDeferredFirstSend` gains `onHeldChange`: it reports the user's held message (never a stash targeted at another agent surface, i.e. the handoff seed) when it is stashed or joined, `null` when it is replayed or rolled back, and, on mount, the stash a replaced pane left behind, from a layout effect so the id-keyed remount never paints an empty thread. Only a committed pane is told (see Acceptance notes for why). `ChatPane` keeps it in state and draws `shownMessages`: the runtime messages plus the user's bubble and an empty streaming assistant turn, which `ChatbotEnhanced` draws as its existing thinking dots. No new visual language and no new string. When the replay sends, the stash and the drawn bubble clear in the same task, and `useObjectChat`'s own optimistic bubble takes over, so it is drawn once.
- **A second message typed during the wait** joins the held one as since #33333, and the drawn bubble shows the joined text, first part first.
- **The create failure has a signal.** `useChatConversation` returns `createError`: set when a create fails, tagged the way `useObjectChat` tags a send that never left the client (`notSent: true`, plus `status` when the server answered), cleared when the next create starts, when the surface settles empty, and whenever a conversation is held. This covers both the create a send starts and a request recorded during a still-running resolve that `settlePending` → `createFor` makes later, which used to fail with nobody told. `ensureConversation`'s contract is unchanged (it still resolves `undefined` on failure).
- **The rollback is the existing one.** `ChatPane` hands `createError` to `ChatbotEnhanced` as its `error` (ahead of the chat's own), so its not-sent restore puts the typed text back in the box and `SendErrorNotice` shows the generic "Couldn't send your message" line, both unchanged. A new `createError` also clears the user's held message from the stash, so a retry sends it once.
- **Hosts.** The `/ai` page, the console dock (`ChatDockConversation`) and the Studio copilot (`StudioAiCopilot`) each pass `conversationCreateError={createError}`; the drawing needs no host change.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33420-ai-chat-first-message-drawn.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private; console's `dist` ships it).

## Tests

- New `AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx`, through the REAL `AiChatPage` / `ChatDockConversation`, `ChatPane`, `useChatConversation`, `useObjectChat` transport and `ChatbotEnhanced`, driven through the composer (type, submit the form), with `POST /conversations` held open until the test answers it:
  - on the full-page chat and on the console dock: create held → the bubble is in the thread before it answers; answered → the chat request carries the message and it is drawn exactly once after the remount;
  - on both hosts: create fails (503) → the bubble is gone, the text is back in the composer, the send-error notice shows, nothing was sent; sending again retries the create, sends once and the notice goes;
  - a second message typed during the wait is drawn too, after the first, and both go out as the joined first turn;
  - a send recorded while the resolve of a cached (gone) conversation is still running rolls back the same way when the create it then makes fails;
  - CONTROL: a send in an existing conversation (`/ai/build/conv-7`) creates nothing and draws and sends as before.
- `useChatConversation.test.tsx`: the failed-create test now also asserts `createError` is `{ notSent: true, status: 500 }` and cleared after the retry; new: a create recorded during the resolve that then fails (network) is reported.
- Red first, on `origin/main` f068cde8 (the pin file alone, before any source change): 5/5 failed (the drawn pins `expected +0 to be 1`; the CONTROL failed on a harness timing, fixed by letting the deep-linked conversation open before typing, see Acceptance notes).
- Ablations, one-off through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (app-shell tests read `src`, no rebuild), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - the drawing removed (`messages={shownMessages}` → `messages={runtimeMessages}`): 6 failed / 1 passed (only the CONTROL stays green);
  - the failure signal removed (the hook returns `createError: undefined`): 3 failed / 4 passed (the three failure pins, at "bubble gone").

## Acceptance notes

- **A send that reaches an uncommitted pane.** The first cut reported the held message from the send itself, and `ChatDock.requestContext-30043.test.tsx` ("on a record page…", which sends through the first `ChatbotEnhanced` props it sees) went red: React warned "Can't perform a React state update on a component that hasn't mounted yet" and the stash was lost. Bisected to the state update in the send (removing it alone turns the file green). The report now goes only to a committed pane (`committedRef`), and the mount report covers the pane once it commits; the file is 7/7 green.
- **Two sends, then a failed create (measured, a narrow-path change).** The existing restore puts back the text the composer itself last submitted (`ChatbotEnhanced`'s own last-submitted text). A one-off probe through the same rendered harness (two sends during a held create, the create answers 503, then resend what the box holds) read `box = "second part"` and the retried chat request `["second part"]`: the first message is dropped with the stash. Before this change both stayed hidden in the stash and went out with whatever the user sent next. Giving the joined text back needs `ChatbotEnhanced` (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`) to take the text to restore from the host, outside this card's surface; reported for the seat to file.
- **A handoff seed is not drawn** and is kept in the stash on a failed create, as before: the user did not type it here, and there is nothing of theirs to restore.
- **The latency of `POST /conversations` is unchanged** (the card's ⛔).
- Observed while building the CONTROL, not chased: on a deep link to an existing conversation (`/ai/build/conv-7`), a message submitted before the conversation's GET answered was not sent within 4 s in this harness (no chat POST, composer cleared, not queued). Mechanism not read; the CONTROL types once the conversation is open.
